content:
We just released lean4-json-schema, a library for deriving JSON Schema from Lean 4 types, with compile-time proofs that serialization always validates against the derived schema.

The core idea: you derive HasJSONSchema, ToJson, and ValidatesAgainstSchema on your type, and Lean's kernel verifies that for every value of that type, toJson produces JSON that validates against the schema. If your type and your serializer don't agree with the schema, the proof doesn't go through, and the code doesn't compile.

It handles structures, enums, inductive types with mixed constructors, recursive types (with proper $defs/$ref), and polymorphic types. The validateJson function is total, which is what makes the theorems possible.

This came out of our work on Predictable Code, where we needed to derive JSON Schemas from Lean types to use with LLM structured output.

GitHub: https://github.com/predictable-machines/lean4-json-schema
Announcement post: https://predictablemachines.com/blog/announcing-lean4-json-schema/

Feedback, issues, and PRs are more than welcome :heart: .
Congrats! Can I encourage you to submit the validator portion to Bowtie so that it shows up on https://bowtie.report/
